Title: Strategic Finance & Growth Lead

Location: Pune - Full time office Job

Exp: 4 - 8 Years

Timing: 3pm -11pm | Monday to Saturday (2nd & 4th Saturday Off)

Joining: Immediate

Website: https://www.chatwithads.com/

Address: NIBM road, Pune

We are looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused Strategic Finance & Growth Lead to work directly with the founder across multiple fast-growing business..

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving business problems, building financial clarity, supporting expansion decisions, and helping prepare companies for long-term scale and investment readiness.

You will work closely with leadership on finance, operations, growth strategy, forecasting, and fundraising preparation.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Finance

- Build and manage financial models, forecasts, and budgeting

- Track cash flow, profitability, margins, and operational efficiency

- Create business performance dashboards and KPI reports

- Analyse business units, projects, and expansion opportunities

- Support pricing, cost optimisation, and financial planning

Growth & Strategy

- Conduct market and competitor research

- Assist in identifying new growth opportunities and partnerships

- Support expansion planning and operational scaling

- Build strategic reports and founder-level insights

- Improve systems, workflows, and business processes

Fundraising & Investor Readiness

- Assist in preparing investor decks and financial documentation

- Maintain data rooms and investment materials

- Research investors, strategic partners, and market opportunities

- Coordinate investor communication and follow-ups

- Track company metrics and growth performance

Founder Office Support

- Work directly with the founder on high-level business priorities

- Convert ideas into structured plans and execution frameworks

- Prepare summaries, analysis, and recommendations for key decisions

- Help drive accountability and execution across departments

Requirements

- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

- Excellent skills in Excel / Google Sheets / financial modeling

- Understanding of startups, SaaS, operations, or growth businesses

- Ability to move fast and handle multiple projects simultaneously

- Strong communication and presentation skills

- Highly organised with attention to detail

- Self-driven and execution-oriented mindset

Preferred Background

- Startup finance

- FP&A

- Consulting

- Corporate strategy

- Investment banking analyst

- Founder’s office

- Venture-backed startup operations

Bonus Skills

- AI tools and automation knowledge

- SaaS metrics understanding

- Dashboarding and reporting

- Investor relations exposure

- Business intelligence tools

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will work at the intersection of data, AI, and finance, building intelligent tools, workflows, and applications that replace manual analysis with scalable, AI-driven systems. You will design workflows, write prompts, build applications, and ensure outputs are accurate before they reach stakeholders.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
1. Build AI-powered workflows and tools (Primary Focus)
• Design and build agentic experiences and reusable AI workflows (skills) that encode repeatable finance workflows

• Write and iterate on structured prompts (YAML, Markdown, or equivalent) to improve output quality

• Build tools that allow non-technical users to generate high-quality outputs from simple inputs

• Evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs before they are used in decision-making

2. Develop data and analytics foundations
• Build and improve semantic data models for natural language querying

• Work with Snowflake, dbt, and Airflow to support scalable data pipelines

• Maintain reliable, source-of-truth reporting outputs

3. Drive end-to-end analytics and stakeholder delivery
• Partner with finance and technical stakeholders to identify use cases across analysis, reporting, and workflow automation

• Translate business needs into scalable data models, pipelines, and AI-driven solutions

• Build reusable, scalable applications using Streamlit (or similar frameworks) to develop internal tools and demo applications that showcase Snowflake-native use cases, applying shared components and design patterns.

• Ingest, validate, and model data from core systems to build reliable analytics foundations

• Analyze data to answer key business questions and build apps/tools for ongoing, self-serve insights

• Support user testing, QA, and iteration to ensure outputs meet stakeholder needs

• Maintain clear documentation for data models, metrics, and workflows

• Identify gaps in processes, data, or systems, and drive improvements

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Core skills
• 3+ years of experience in Data Analytics, BI, or BI Engineering

• Strong SQL skills for analysis, data transformation, and building scalable datasets

• Strong Python skills (pandas, numpy) for data processing and application development

• Experience working with modern data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift etc.)

• Experience working with tools such as dbt, Airflow, and Git

• Solid understanding of data modelling and building datasets for self-serve analytics.

AI-Native Expectations
We are specifically hiring candidates who actively build with AI.
AI-assisted development (daily usage)
• You use an LLM coding assistant (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or equivalent) as your primary development tool

• You can:
• Write prompts that generate usable, production-ready code

• Steer and refine outputs when the model goes off-track

• Encode reusable logic into structured workflows or tools

Prompt engineering & structured thinking
• You can design structured prompts (YAML, Markdown, or similar) that:
• Produce reliable outputs consistently

• Handle edge cases and ambiguity

• Encode domain knowledge through context, examples, and constraints

Ways of Working
• You turn ambiguous problems into clear, structured outputs

• You think in workflows and reusable systems, not one-off analyses

• You move quickly while maintaining a high bar for accuracy

• You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders

• You are comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and prioritizing effectively

• You have a strong ownership mindset and bring structure and clarity to complex problems

• You have high attention to detail and a strong focus on data quality

NICE TO HAVE
• Experience with finance, accounting, or supporting finance stakeholders

• Experience building internal tools or user-facing data applications

• Familiarity with semantic layers or natural language querying systems

• Familiarity with ERP or financial planning systems

• Experience working in agile environments (sprints, iterative development)

• Experience with Streamlit or similar app frameworks

• You demonstrate a bias for action and focus on delivering outcomes

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 3 MONTHS)
• Build and deploy at least one AI-driven workflow or tool used by finance stakeholders

• Contribute to or deploy a semantic model enabling self-serve analysis

• Automate at least one recurring finance or reporting workflow

• Deliver outputs that stakeholders trust and use in decision-making

WHY JOIN THIS TEAM?
Joining this team means working at the frontier of AI-native analytics, where you will help define how agentic workflows reshape the future of finance operations at one of the most innovative data companies in the world. You will have the opportunity to build tools that are actually used — by real stakeholders, at scale — and see the direct impact of your work on how decisions get made.
If you’re excited about building AI-driven systems, working with modern data tools, and solving ambiguous business problems, this role offers a strong opportunity to grow.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
How do you want to make your impact?
For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

Ecolab is seeking a Senior FP&A Transformation Leader to lead the modernization of FP&A insights and reporting Globally by enabling scalable, interactive, and AI-enabled analytics.

What’s in it For You:

• Join a growth company offering a competitive salary and benefits.

• Make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth.

• Be supported by an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best.

• Feel proud each day to work for a company that provides clean water, safe food, abundant energy and healthy environments.

What You Will Do:

• This role is based in Pune, India (hybrid). You will partner across Finance, Technology, Data, and Analytics to transform how the business consumes FP&A insights—moving from static reporting to interactive, self-service, and AI-enabled decision support system

Where You’ll Make a Difference

• Lead end-to-end transformation of FP&A dashboards—evolving static reporting into interactive, AI-enabled insights that support decision-making.

• Standardization across region, FP&A reporting using standard Tools Technology stack

• Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to translate business needs into scalable analytics products and AI-driven solutions.

• Define, standardize, and govern finance logic, KPIs, and insight narratives embedded in dashboards to drive consistent outcomes.

• Design intuitive self-service experiences (Copilot-like finance insights) that deliver fast, relevant, decision-ready information.

• Serve as the finance approval authority for dashboard designs, analytics models, and automated insights—ensuring alignment to finance governance and business priorities.

• Drive stakeholder adoption and value realization of analytics solutions across global finance and business partners.

• Demonstrate ownership and accountability with a sustained focus on business impact, value creation, and continuous improvement.

Key Stakeholders & Operating Model

• Partner with Divisional Finance leadership and FP&A teams to translate planning, forecasting, and performance needs into dashboard roadmaps and prioritized releases.

• Work closely with Global BI / Data & Analytics teams (e.g., MAP 2.0 / FP&A datasets) to ensure scalable design, data quality, and performance.

• Collaborate with Finance Systems and enterprise data/platform teams to align to governance, security access, refresh SLAs, and change management processes.

• Engage with functional and adjacent finance partners (e.g., CP&A, Supply Chain Finance, Commercial Finance) to standardize KPIs and definitions across reporting suites.

Success Measures (First 6–12 Months)

• Deliver a prioritized transformation roadmap and release cadence for NA FP&A dashboards (with clear scope, owners, milestones, and sign-offs).

• Improve usability and stakeholder adoption of the reporting suite (measured through active users, repeat usage, and stakeholder feedback from UX sessions).

• Strengthen trust in data and definitions by establishing standard KPI logic, tie-out routines, and governance documentation for key dashboards.

• Reduce manual effort and cycle time for recurring FP&A insights (e.g., month-end and forecast cycles) through automation and self-serve analytics.

• Launch at least 2–3 high-value enhancements (e.g., open orders / MTG projection views, daily movement “walks”, persona-based insight narratives) with measurable business impact.

What Makes You the Right Fit

• 12–14+ years of experience in Finance, FP&A, and/or Finance Transformation roles within complex or matrixed environments.

• Proven experience leading dashboard, analytics, or reporting transformations, including modernization of FP&A insights.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, performance management, and enterprise-level financial metrics.

• Hands-on exposure to BI tools and analytics platforms (e.g., Power BI or similar) and familiarity with AI-enabled reporting solutions.

• Demonstrated ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable business insights and storylines.

• Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences.

How Would You Stand Out?

• Experience operating in a global or multi-regional context with an understanding of standard finance governance, access controls, and sign-off processes.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align Finance, Technology, and business teams on priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery timelines.

• Experience with modern data and BI stacks (e.g., Power BI, semantic models, SQL; familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Azure and/or Snowflake).

• A product mindset—comfortable running discovery, defining personas and user journeys, and delivering iterative releases (Agile) with measurable outcomes.

Qualifications:

• Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field (MBA preferred).

• Experience leading finance transformation programs, including process, reporting, and/or analytics modernization.

• Proficiency applying automation and AI concepts to strengthen analytics capability (e.g., driver-based insights, forecasting enablement, narrative generation).

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.

Tooling & Technical Preferences:

• Strong Power BI capability (data modeling, DAX fundamentals, performance optimization, and dashboard UX best practices).

• Data scientist having worked in Global Projects including FP&A transformation

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Azure services and/or Snowflake) and an understanding of refresh SLAs and data quality controls.

• Understanding of security and governance concepts (role-based access, personas, finance definition control, change management, and production deployment discipline).

• Understanding of AI products that can be scaled at an Enterprise level for FP&A Analytics

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging
Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

Finance Assistant / Senior Lead Associate - Financial Reporting 

Department: Accounting & Finance 

Employment Type: Permanent - Full Time 

Location: Pune 

Description 

The Financial Assistant supports the delivery of high-quality financial accounting and reporting across the Group. The role contributes to statutory reporting, consolidation processes, acquisition accounting , and ongoing improvements to financial controls , ensuring accuracy and compliance in a fast-paced environment. The position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively within a high performing Finance function. 

Key Responsibilities 

IFRS Accounting & Technical Support 

• Support the Group Financial Accountant with the application of IFRS across the Group. 
• Assist in preparing IFRS aligned workings and supporting documentation for audit and statutory reporting. 
Group Reporting 

• Assist in preparing the monthly holding company trial balances. 
• Support the preparation of statutory financial statements for legal entities across the Group. 
• Ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance in all areas of statutory and management reporting. 
Group Reporting & Consolidation

Job Overview:

DSIJ is looking for a highly experienced and result-oriented Senior Equity Research Manager to lead and strengthen our equity research and advisory function. The role requires deep expertise in the Indian equity markets, strong research capabilities, and leadership skills to manage a team of analysts while delivering high-quality stock research and actionable investment recommendations and monitoring content writing assignments.
Key Responsibilities:

1. Equity Research & Stock Analysis:

• Conduct in-depth fundamental analysis of listed Indian companies across sectors, including financial modeling, valuation, and earnings analysis.

• Perform detailed financial analysis, valuation analysis and scenario analysis.

• Interpret financial statements, earnings reports, management commentary, corporate actions, industry developments and regulatory developments.

• Prepare comprehensive equity research reports, investment notes, and stock recommendations.

• Monitor portfolio stocks and update views based on market developments.

• Co-ordinating and monitoring content writing assignments such as daily market commentary, analysing stock market trends, key indices, and economic events, breaking news and updates in the financial markets.

• Create in-depth articles that simplify complex financial concepts, educational content for the readers.

2. Advisory & Investment Strategy:

• Generate actionable investment ideas aligned with DSIJs advisory philosophy.

• Develop medium- to long-term investment strategies based on macroeconomic and sector trends.

• Support portfolio construction and performance review activities.

• Develop and implement investment themes and strategies based on

• macroeconomic, sector-specific, or market-driven insights.

3. Market & Sector Coverage:

• Track market trends, indices, and sector developments.

• Publish market outlooks, sector reports, and thematic investment ideas.

4. Team Leadership & Mentoring:

• Lead and mentor a team of equity research analysts.

• Review research outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance,

• Conduct training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

• Ensure the team delivers high-quality, accurate, and timely research reports.

• Foster a collaborative environment within the team, encouraging knowledge sharing and professional growth.

• Provide constructive feedback and support to analysts to enhance their research skills and output.

5. Compliance & Process Adherence:

• Ensure compliance with SEBI regulations and internal guidelines.

• Coordinate with compliance teams for disclosures and audits.

Skills & Qualifications:

• MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, or equivalent.

• 7-10 years of experience in equity research or investment advisory.

• Strong expertise in financial modeling, valuation, and Indian equity markets.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills.

· Role Purpose

The SOX BU coordinator role is responsible for documenting, highlighting, updating the risk involved in various processes. Work as a liaison between BU and Corporate SOX Team / Auditors to align the expectations and adhere to the Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance requirements. The role ensures that process narratives, risk and control matrices (RCMs), and flowcharts accurately reflect current operations and support effective internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR).

· Key Responsibilities

SOX Process responsibilities

· Ensure documentation aligns with SOX 404 and internal control frameworks (e.g., COSO).

· Identify and document key risks, control objectives, key controls, and SOX-relevant assertions (completeness, accuracy, existence, valuation, cutoff).

· Assess control design effectiveness during documentation and identify gaps or redundancies.

· Assess & Update documentation for process changes due to system implementations, reorganizations, or regulatory updates.

· Work closely with process owners and coordinators to validate accuracy and completeness of documentation.

· Ensure documentation reflects US GAAP, company policies, and SOX standards.

Stakeholder & Audit Support

· Act as a liaison between process owners, internal audit, external auditors, and SOX teams.

· Support walkthroughs by explaining documented processes and controls to auditors.

· Incorporate audit feedback and remediation actions into updated documentation.

Governance & Quality

· Ensure documentation standards, templates, and naming conventions are followed consistently.

· Maintain version control and audit trails for all SOX documentation.

· Support annual SOX scoping, refresh, and certification cycles.

· Work at US overlap hours in general and concurrent hours during key SOX milestones (walkthroughs, audit cycles, close periods)

· Drive standardization, scalability, and documentation quality across global processes.

BU specific responsibilities

· Support business specific activities as may be needed.

Qualifications

Experience
• 8 – 11 years of experience

Education & Certifications
• CPA / CA / CIA / CISA - Final / Intermediate

Technical / Functional
• Strong understanding of SOX 404 and Internal Controls over Financial Reporting (ICFR).
• Hands-on experience with process narratives, RCMs, and flowcharts.
• Knowledge of key finance processes
• Familiarity with COSO framework.
• Experience working with ERPs and other financial tools.

Soft Skills
• Excellent process thinking and documentation skills.
• Strong stakeholder management and interviewing skills.
• Attention to detail with the ability to simplify complex processes.
• Good written and verbal communication.

About the Department:

The corporate finance department in the company handles all the financial and investment decisions. It primarily focuses on maximizing shareholder value through long-term and short-term financial planning and the implementation of various strategies. It aims to maximize the value of a business through the planning and execution of resources.

The Role & Responsibilities

The Sr. Associate/Vice President, Accounts Payable, and the payroll are responsible for managing and supervising all finance and accounts functions, ensuring the proper maintenance of accounting systems and the timely delivery of accounts payable and payroll services (domestic and international). These roles require strict adherence to deadlines, government legislation, internal policies, and established procedures. As senior leadership and operational roles respectively, both positions involve overseeing the accuracy and compliance of financial processes, leading teams, optimising payment and payroll operations, and collaborating closely with finance, procurement, operations, and senior stakeholders. Each role also participates in special projects to develop, improve, and maintain effective, efficient, and compliant practices, contributing to departmental goals and overall service delivery. The individuals must demonstrate strong adaptability to a continually evolving environment while effectively managing their teams.

Efficiency & Operational Excellence

▪ Lead end-to-end payroll operations across multiple countries, ensuring timely and accurate processing

▪ Manage monthly and off-cycle payroll cycles with a focus on lean execution and minimal errors

▪ Maintain payroll calendars, reconciliation schedules, and compliance trackers across multiple countries and regions, including the UK, US, and Singapore

▪ Ensure accurate and timely payroll delivery through standard monthly cycles and off-cycle payments as needed

Strategic Leadership

▪ Develop and implement policies for accounts payable operations aligned with corporate finance objectives

▪ Drive automation and process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs

Operational Management

▪ Oversee end-to-end accounts payable processes, including invoice verification, approvals, and disbursements

▪ Ensure compliance with tax regulations, GST, and internal audit requirements

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

▪ Maintain strong relationships with vendors and resolve escalated payment issues

▪ Collaborate with procurement and treasury teams for cash flow optimization

Automation & Innovation

▪ Drive automation initiatives using HCM platforms for payroll, benefits, and time tracking

▪ Evaluate and implement cutting-edge payroll technologies to enhance accuracy and efficiency

▪ Collaborate with IT and compliance teams to integrate secure, scalable payroll solutions

Stakeholder Experience & Communication

▪ Serve as the primary contact for accounts payable-related queries from employees, auditors, and consultants

▪ Ensure all communication materials are accurate, accessible, and user-friendly

▪ Collect and act on stakeholder feedback to improve transparency and satisfaction

Prerequisites

▪ Experience in managing audits and implementing internal controls

▪ Passion for continuous learning and professional development

▪ Extremely strong fundamentals in accounting

▪ Relationship Management with cross functions

▪ Proactive and entrepreneurial traits; and a willingness to grow and learn on daily basis

Job Description

The Finance Planning and Analyst (FP&A) at NielsenIQ is a key member of the FP&A Hub team, responsible for supporting the local team in managing financial planning processes. This role involves integrating and developing financial processes that align with both revenue and expense goals, participating in strategic planning, and contributing to global and local strategies. The FP&A team is a dynamic group of young professionals eager to learn, collaborate, and add value to the company. The successful candidate will demonstrate proactive collaboration with peers and leaders and contribute their analytical expertise to drive financial success.

Key Responsibilities:
• Revenue Management and Forecasting: Support local countries' client teams with revenue management and forecasting, including managing weekly pacing updates.
• Variance Analysis: Contribute to monthly variance analysis to identify and explain financial performance deviations.
• SIP Payment Review: Ensure SIP payment information aligns with agreed-upon data.
• Expense Budget Management: Manage expense budgets and ensure leaders remain on plan.
• Headcount Forecasting: Prepare and track headcount forecast dashboards.
• Strategic Planning: Meaningfully contribute to the preparation of the Three-Year Plan, Annual Operating Budget, and Quarterly targets.
• P&L Reporting: Consolidate, analyze, and report P&L, including commercial and PTO expenses.
• Reporting and Analysis: Prepare reports and crib notes for quarterly Op Reviews and F Cycles.
• Special Projects: Support special projects to drive exceptional revenue growth across the LATAM and Global teams.
• Financial Process Integration: Develop and implement financial processes that meet revenue and expense needs, ensuring alignment with global and local strategies.
• Collaboration: Work closely with peers, leaders, and other functional areas to gather necessary data and provide financial insights.
• Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and efficiencies within financial planning and analysis activities.
• Compliance: Ensure all financial activities comply with internal policies and external regulations.

Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 2 yrs of proven experience in financial planning and analysis, preferably within a global organization.
• Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
• Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in financial software and tools, including advanced Excel skills and experience with financial planning systems.
• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly present financial information to various stakeholders.
• Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with peers and leaders across different functional areas.
• Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing financial issues.
• Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.
• Ethics: High level of integrity and ethical standards in managing confidential financial information

• Volunteer time off
